## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in City of London, United Kingdom. It starts at The Beatles Story, Britannia Vaults, Royal Albert Dock, Liverpool L3 4AD, Великобритания. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Immerse yourself in the incredible journey of the world’s greatest band with your entry ticket to The Beatles Story in Liverpool. Located on the iconic Albert Dock, this award-winning attraction is the ultimate destination for fans of The Fab Four and music enthusiasts alike.
>
> Explore the lives, music, and legacy of John, Paul, George, and Ringo through captivating exhibits, authentic memorabilia, and interactive displays. Wander through recreated locations that played a key role in their story, including the legendary Cavern Club and Abbey Road Studios. From their humble beginnings in Liverpool to their meteoric rise to global fame, every step of The Beatles' journey comes alive.
>
> The experience also features rare photographs, instruments, and personal items, offering a closer look at the band’s creative process and enduring influence on music and culture. Don’t forget to visit the immersive audio guide narrated by John Lennon’s sister, Julia, for exclusive insights and stories.
>
> Whether you’re a lifelong fan or discovering their magic for the first time, The Beatles Story is an unforgettable tribute to the band that changed the world. Book your ticket now and relive the timeless music and spirit of The Beatles!

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €26.94. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 129 ratings and 98 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
